description.value: Operating under the brand 'The Adventure Group,' this multi-activity adventure complex sits on Cougar Mountain just north of Whistler and offers whitewater rafting, ziplining, side-by-side off-road tours, an aerial obstacle course, snowmobile and snowshoe tours, and the Vallea Lumina night walk. A free shuttle runs from Whistler Village to the base camp, where guests can also eat at an on-site café. It bills itself as Whistler's only local whitewater rafting operation.

address.value: Sixteen Mile Creek Forest Service Road, Whistler, BC V0N 1B8
